evidenceBundle.claimBoundary: Workspace evidence calibrates future planning assumptions; it does not convert modeled information gain into causal, monetary, regulatory, or health outcomes.

claimBoundary: The next-round portfolio updates normalized planning curves from saved workspace evidence. It is not online causal learning, a regulatory funding recommendation, or proof that one domain produces greater physical or health benefit than another.

profile.label: Balanced
profile.description: Balances normalized scientific value, exposure, equity, ecology, intervention readiness, reliability, and cross-domain parity.

profile.label: Maximum Information
profile.description: Prioritizes normalized within-domain information gain while retaining minimum viable programs and reliability.

profile.label: Exposure Protection
profile.description: Emphasizes monitoring value at populated, mobile, and sensitive receptor locations.

profile.label: Equity First
profile.description: Maximizes vulnerable-group information quality and protects the least-served environmental domain.

profile.label: Reliability and Intervention
profile.description: Favors dependable programs that can support longitudinal monitoring and intervention evaluation.

profile.label: Cost Efficient
profile.description: Seeks the strongest normalized program value per committed dollar after satisfying active minimum-program rules.
